build_single_header: run acme on a top-level C++ header file to create a single-header library output
simplify_expression: simplify a C preprocessor conditional expression with forced defines to a boolean result
normalize_expression: normalize a defined() expression to an ifdef or ifndef directive with the macro name
sort_includes: sort a list of C include directives into system and local groups in order
sort_copyrights: sort and deduplicate copyright lines by email, merging year ranges into a single line
